subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A growth badge, a bronze-rimmed round medal with a grass-green field; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with a sprouting ear of wheat growing out of the page laid over the middle of the page.

items.notes: 语法：类满页组用该事迹类别的徽章外形（与事迹徽章同边色同底色），中央是摊开的满页加类别纹样。打包时合成在深色底上；未达成的灰图由打包脚本去饱和加压暗生成，不另出提示词。表示该类事迹满页；书页上的小徽章只是图形，不画字。

subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A named beasts badge, a dark silver eight-pointed star badge with a night-blue field; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with an eight-pointed star-shaped paw print laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：异名者。外形为多角章：八角星，暗银边（#9aa0a8），八个角尖各点一粒暗红，底色夜蓝（#2e3a5a）。
extra.en: Category: named beasts. Multi-pointed badge: an eight-pointed star with a dark silver rim (#9aa0a8), each point tipped with a dark red dot, night-blue field (#2e3a5a).

items.notes: 语法：类满页组用该事迹类别的徽章外形（与事迹徽章同边色同底色），中央是摊开的满页加类别纹样。打包时合成在深色底上；未达成的灰图由打包脚本去饱和加压暗生成，不另出提示词。表示该类事迹满页；书页上的小徽章只是图形，不画字。

subject.zh: 类满页成就图标：一枚迷宫类徽章，石灰边、青灰底的城垛方盾章；中央是一页摊开的书页，每一行都排满了小小的徽章图形，页面正中叠着一座城垛形的小石门。
subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A dungeons badge, a stone-gray crenellated square shield badge with a slate field; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with a small crenellated stone gate laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：迷宫。外形为盾章：顶边是城垛形的平底方盾，石灰色边（#8a8e8a），底色青灰（#464a5a）。
extra.en: Category: dungeons. Shield badge: a flat-bottomed square shield with a crenellated top edge, stone-gray rim (#8a8e8a), slate field (#464a5a).

subject.zh: 类满页成就图标：一枚探索类徽章，铜绿边、天蓝底的罗盘圆章；中央是一页摊开的书页，每一行都排满了小小的徽章图形，页面正中叠着一根罗盘指针。
subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A exploration badge, a verdigris round medal with compass points and a sky-blue field; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with a compass needle laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：探索。外形为圆章：铜绿色边（#4e8a78），边上四个方位各伸出一个小尖，像罗盘，底色天蓝（#6aa0d8）。
extra.en: Category: exploration. Round medal: verdigris copper rim (#4e8a78) with four small compass points on the rim, sky-blue field (#6aa0d8).

subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A collections badge, a bright gold beaded round medal with a wine-red field; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with a small open display case laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：收藏。外形为圆章：亮金边（#d8b45a），边上一圈连珠，底色酒红（#6e2a3a）。
extra.en: Category: collections. Round medal: bright gold rim (#d8b45a) with a ring of beads, wine-red field (#6e2a3a).

subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A bonds badge, a silver-rimmed round medal with a cream field and red ribbons; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with two clasped hands laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：社交与羁绊。外形为圆章：银边（#c8ccd0），章下垂着一对打了结的暖红绶带（#b83a2a），底色暖米（#e6d4b0）。
extra.en: Category: bonds. Round medal: silver rim (#c8ccd0) with a pair of knotted warm red ribbons (#b83a2a) hanging below, warm cream field (#e6d4b0).

subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A stewardship badge, a brass-rimmed riveted octagonal plaque with a deep green field; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with a small rooftop with cooking smoke laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：经营。外形为多角章：八边形牌，黄铜边（#b8943a），四个斜边各钉一颗铆钉，底色墨绿（#2e5a3a）。
extra.en: Category: stewardship. Multi-pointed badge: an octagonal plaque with a brass rim (#b8943a), a rivet on each diagonal edge, deep green field (#2e5a3a).

subject.zh: 类满页成就图标：一枚战争类徽章，钢蓝边、背衬交叉剑尖的尖底盾章；中央是一页摊开的书页，每一行都排满了小小的徽章图形，页面正中叠着一面竖起的军旗。
subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A war badge, a steel-blue heater shield badge with crossed sword tips behind it; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with a raised war banner laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：战争。外形为盾章：尖底骑士盾，钢蓝边（#5a6e8c），盾后斜伸出两柄交叉的剑尖，底色钢灰蓝（#3e4a5e）。
extra.en: Category: war. Shield badge: a pointed heater shield with a steel-blue rim (#5a6e8c), two crossed sword tips jutting out from behind it, steel slate field (#3e4a5e).

subject.zh: 类满页成就图标：一枚诸神类徽章，淡金边、象牙白底的十二芒放射章；中央是一页摊开的书页，每一行都排满了小小的徽章图形，页面正中叠着五个排成弧形的小神纹：光轮、断剑、硬币、枝叶、书卷。
subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A goddesses badge, a pale gold twelve-rayed sunburst badge with an ivory field; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with five small divine emblems in an arc: a halo wheel, a broken sword, a coin, a leafy sprig and a scroll laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：诸神。外形为多角章：十二道短芒的放射章，淡金边（#d0b070），底色象牙白（#eeeae2）。
extra.en: Category: the goddesses. Multi-pointed badge: a sunburst badge with twelve short rays, pale gold rim (#d0b070), ivory field (#eeeae2).

subject.zh: 类满页成就图标：一枚凡人不信类徽章，铁链挂着、四角包铁的旧木牌章；中央是一页摊开的书页，每一行都排满了小小的徽章图形，页面正中叠着一块裂开的鉴定水晶。
subject.en: Full-page achievement icon: A mortals do not believe badge, an iron-bound old wooden plaque badge hung on short chains; at its center an open book page whose every line is filled with tiny badge shapes, with a cracked appraisal crystal laid over the middle of the page.

extra.zh: 类别：凡人不信。外形为卷轴章的变体：一块用两段短铁链挂着的旧木牌，木色（#8a6a4a），四角包铁。
extra.en: Category: mortals do not believe. A variant of the scroll badge: an old wooden plaque hung from two short iron chains, wood color (#8a6a4a), iron-bound corners.

items.notes: 语法：类满页组用该事迹类别的徽章外形（与事迹徽章同边色同底色），中央是摊开的满页加类别纹样。打包时合成在深色底上；未达成的灰图由打包脚本去饱和加压暗生成，不另出提示词。表示该类事迹满页；书页上的小徽章只是图形，不画字。

subject.zh: 全簿成就图标，一本立着的深棕色厚书：书脊上一道金箍，十一个小圆点依次是草绿、暗红、夜蓝、青灰、天蓝、酒红、暖米、墨绿、钢灰蓝、象牙白与木色，合上的书页边缘透出一线金光。
subject.en: Full-book achievement icon, an upright dark brown thick book: A gold band on the spine, eleven small dots in grass green, dark red, night blue, slate, sky blue, wine red, warm cream, deep green, steel slate, ivory and wood brown, a line of gold light showing at the edge of the closed pages.

extra.zh: 成就组：全簿。外形为一本立着的厚书，书皮深棕（#4a3a2a），四角包金，书的四周绕着一圈小圆点。
extra.en: Achievement group: the full book. An upright thick book with a dark brown cover (#4a3a2a) and gold-capped corners, ringed by a circle of small dots.

items.notes: 语法：全簿组统一外形见补充说明，中央纹样逐条不同。打包时合成在深色底上；未达成的灰图由打包脚本去饱和加压暗生成，不另出提示词。十一个圆点对应十一个可计类的底色，要数得清。

subject.zh: 铁人成就图标，一枚厚铁圆盾，中央是一只铁手套稳稳握着一盏小提灯，灯火是不灭的暖白，手套上有许多旧划痕。
subject.en: Iron-rule achievement icon, a thick round iron shield with, at its center, an iron gauntlet steadily holding a small lantern whose warm white flame never goes out, the gauntlet covered in old scratches.

extra.zh: 成就组：铁人。外形为一枚厚铁圆盾（#5a6268），盾沿一圈粗铆钉，中央是图案。
extra.en: Achievement group: iron rule. A thick round iron shield (#5a6268) with a ring of heavy rivets around its rim, the image at its center.

items.notes: 语法：铁人组统一外形见补充说明，中央纹样逐条不同。打包时合成在深色底上；未达成的灰图由打包脚本去饱和加压暗生成，不另出提示词。

subject.zh: 开门成就图标，一圈门扉金细圆环里：三扇小门并排站着，门缝都透出暖金的光，门下是一道短短的台阶。
subject.en: Doors-opened achievement icon, inside a thin ring of door gold: Three small doors standing side by side, warm gold light through each gap, a short step beneath them.

extra.zh: 成就组：开门。外形为一圈门扉金（#f0d890）细圆环，环内并排叠着若干扇小门，门的数量表示里程碑。
extra.en: Achievement group: doors opened. A thin ring of door gold (#f0d890) holding a number of small doors side by side, the number of doors marking the milestone.

items.notes: 语法：开门组统一外形见补充说明，中央纹样逐条不同。打包时合成在深色底上；未达成的灰图由打包脚本去饱和加压暗生成，不另出提示词。三扇要数得清；不画数字。

subject.zh: 开门成就图标，一圈门扉金细圆环里：六扇小门排成两行，门缝都透出暖金的光，门下是两道台阶。
subject.en: Doors-opened achievement icon, inside a thin ring of door gold: Six small doors in two rows, warm gold light through each gap, two steps beneath them.

extra.zh: 成就组：开门。外形为一圈门扉金（#f0d890）细圆环，环内并排叠着若干扇小门，门的数量表示里程碑。
extra.en: Achievement group: doors opened. A thin ring of door gold (#f0d890) holding a number of small doors side by side, the number of doors marking the milestone.

items.notes: 语法：开门组统一外形见补充说明，中央纹样逐条不同。打包时合成在深色底上；未达成的灰图由打包脚本去饱和加压暗生成，不另出提示词。六扇要数得清；不画数字。

subject.zh: 开门成就图标，一圈门扉金细圆环里：十扇小门排成一个拱形，门缝都透出暖金的光，拱顶上一点更亮的光。
subject.en: Doors-opened achievement icon, inside a thin ring of door gold: Ten small doors arranged in an arch, warm gold light through each gap, a brighter point of light at the top of the arch.

extra.zh: 成就组：开门。外形为一圈门扉金（#f0d890）细圆环，环内并排叠着若干扇小门，门的数量表示里程碑。
extra.en: Achievement group: doors opened. A thin ring of door gold (#f0d890) holding a number of small doors side by side, the number of doors marking the milestone.
